_about: Hall of Fame record (List 13 #126). Written once per capstone clear, at the moment #100's clear flag (story.champion_defeated, #12) is set — first clear and every rematch clear (#100 ladders / #87), append-only, never overwritten. The one deliberately denormalised store in the architecture: a snapshot, because history must not change when the living record does (contrast #98: the licence's standing is DERIVED over these facts and stores nothing). Names are never stored — species/individual rendering resolves through #23 lookups at read time, so the archive stays rename-safe. Snapshot rows copy ids and facts (species, honour ids held at the clear per #104, move ids known at the clear) so a team member later traded (#68) or released (#106) still appears in the run it won. Zero records exist — no clear has happened and none is fabricated here.
